requirements.text: POST /orders accepts a customerId and one or more lines, each containing a sku and a positive quantity.
The service rejects a line whose SKU is unknown or whose quantity is zero or negative.
A successful request creates an order with status CREATED, calculates the line-total sum, and emits order.created with the new order identifier.

source.text: CreateOrderService.create validates the customer and line SKU/quantity, saves an Order.created instance, publishes OrderCreated with the order ID, and returns the order.
